name: Footer Waterline
description: A footer where a very large word stands on a waterline over a slow swell, with its reflection beneath and links and small print below.

props.name: word
props.description: The wordmark. It is sized to fill the width of the footer exactly, so a word of any length fits at every width and is never clipped, and its baseline stands on the waterline with a wavering reflection below.

props.name: links
props.description: Links in a row under the water.

props.name: children
props.description: Small print beside the links, such as an address and a copyright line.

props.name: maxSize
props.description: The largest the word may be, in pixels, for short words on wide screens.

props.name: waterHeight
props.default: 62% of the word size, at least 5.5rem
props.description: Depth of the water band, in pixels or any CSS length.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the footer element. Other footer props are passed through.
